submitted.rationale: Five EQE measurements were taken along the Ni-Sb-O line. The Sb-rich side, around the NiSb2O6 trirutile composition (Sb ~0.67-0.80), gave essentially no EQE. Sb 0.35 and 0.52 both gave ~0.09%. The midpoint at Sb 0.448 gave the highest value, 0.101%, which points to a broad optimum in the mid-composition region.
